summary: Arbe Robotics Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on September 8, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing that Tier 1 supplier Hirain Technologies was selected by a major automotive group to supply imaging radar powered by Arbe's chipset for a Level 3 automated driving program in China, with series production starting Q4 2027. This is a routine business development disclosure, not a special situation. No transaction terms, prices, or strategic actions are involved. The filing includes forward-looking statements and incorporates the report by reference into registration statements.
